distribution_policy.admission_rule: Captain decision (2026-09-25): a recording may enter the built catalog only when Quran Foundation has confirmed the source in writing. The candidates below are documented but disabled until that written confirmation exists. QuranicAudio-backed recordings are never eligible, and the pipeline still machine-checks each candidate's declared license whenever it is enabled.
distribution_policy.deny_reason: QuranicAudio.com permits personal use only and forbids commercial use; Ezber must not ship QuranicAudio-backed recordings.

fallback_sources.note: Kept as a documented fallback only. It is not a catalog entry and the pipeline has no adapter for it yet; enabling it requires a written license confirmation and a per-ayah or per-word timing source that matches the recordings.

word_timing.alignment_policy: quran-align word indices refer to the Tanzil Uthmani text split on spaces (N words). Ezber words are the Tanzil transliteration tokens (M tokens). Per ayah the pipeline repairs the released segments into a non-decreasing piecewise-linear time function f over word positions, aligns tokens to words monotonically by rounding the proportional boundary j*M/N to the nearest token index (so a token never crosses a word boundary; M == N is the identity), then splits each word's span across its tokens by token length (or gives a token spanning several words the union of their spans). Malformed segments are repaired deterministically (reverse start/end swapped, zero-length and out-of-range segments dropped, word-range overlaps clamped, time inversions flattened, uncovered words interpolated between neighbouring aligned words, whole ayahs without segments synthesised from the recitation average word duration) and every repair is counted in the manifest.
